delivery.pr_title: ci: enforce the skills index contract
delivery.pr_body:
Adds .github/workflows/ci.yml so this repository can produce a CI receipt.

There is no build here and never was: the repository is skills.json plus one
directory per skill. So the honest check is the invariant the README already
documents -- "skills.json lists every skill from every week" -- enforced against
the tree, not an `echo ok`.

`scripts/validate-skills.mjs` (dependency-free) checks:

- every entry has non-empty name, slug, description, useFor, path
- path equals skills/<slug>, and that directory exists with a SKILL.md
- that SKILL.md has frontmatter with non-empty name: and description:
- the frontmatter name EQUALS the indexed name (catches a rename in one place)
- slugs are unique
- every directory under skills/ is indexed, and every indexed slug has a directory

PROOF IT IS NOT THEATRE
It passes on the current tree (117 skills across 33 weeks) and was mutation-tested against four
separate corruptions, each of which exits 1 for the right reason: an unindexed
skill directory, a renamed frontmatter name, an index path pointing at a missing
directory, and a removed description. Re-run commands are in the workflow file.

RUNNER
GitHub-hosted on purpose. This repository is public, and
~/ci-local/bin/provision-air-runner.sh refuses to register a self-hosted runner
for a public repository -- persistent self-hosted execution of forkable code.
Hosted minutes are free for public repositories.

Draft delivery candidate created by cloud-delivery-v1. No merge, no deploy.
